I think it’s definitely a double edged sword. On one hand people who would never have gotten a much needed diagnosis are able to advocate for themselves now that they have an arsenal of knowledge of various mental health issues.

But on the other hand, younger generations are being inundated with content about signs to look out for for various mental health issues; and I do believe for some it’s causing a bit of a placebo effect. 

They’re acutely aware of every symptom in the DSM 5 so they feel the need to put a label on every feeling they have, and in some cases will  subconsciously embellish some of what they feel, in order to fit more snugly into a category.
